title: ssDNA Extraction Protocol
author: Franziska Patzold
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8m9hu96
materials: Put the tube in an Mixing Block (MB-102, Thermocell) 56 °C 08:00:00, at least, better overnight Mix gently, and spin again.

steps.title: Grind Tissue
steps.instruction: Grind dry tissue in a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube using an oscillating mill (MM 400, Retsch).

substeps.instruction: Use two sterile stainless steel balls with a diameter of 3 mm
Mill for 1 min at a frequency of 25 Hz

steps.title: Lysis and Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Add lysis buffer and Proteinase K to the ground tissue and mix.

substeps.instruction: Insert 45 µL Lysis buffer and 5 µL Proteinase K (total volume 50 µL)
Mix well by handshaking (do not vortex)
Gently spin down the solution

steps.title: Bind DNA
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for DNA binding using Binding Buffer and ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL DNA Cleanup Binding Buffer to the 50 µL sample mix by pipetting up and down
Add 300 µL ethanol (≥ 95%)
Mix well by pipetting up and down or flicking the tube (do not vortex)

steps.title: Load and Centrifuge Sample
steps.instruction: Load the sample onto the column and centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Insert column into collection tube
Load sample onto column and close the cap
Centrifuge for 1 minute
Discard flow-through

steps.title: Wash DNA
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA on the column to remove contaminants and enzymes.

substeps.instruction: Re-insert column into collection tube
Add 500 µL DNA Wash Buffer
Centrifuge for 1 minute
Discard flow-through
Repeat the wash step once more to ensure removal of enzymes (e.g., Proteinase K)

steps.title: Prepare Column for Elution
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a clean tube and ensure it is dry.

substeps.instruction: Transfer column to a clean 1.5 ml microfuge tube, ensuring the tip does not contact the flow-through
If necessary, re-spin for 1 minute to remove traces of salt and ethanol

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the matrix using Elution Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 17.5 µL Elution Buffer to the center of the matrix
Incubate for 10 minutes
Centrifuge for 1 minute to elute the DNA
Repeat the elution process to extract all remaining DNA
